name: Nizza Monferrato (Italy)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, red above and yellow below, charged at the centre with a crowned yellow lion rampant holding a cross.
history: Municipal flag of Nizza Monferrato, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: crowned lion rampant holding a cross
